draft.text: You came in because you had a recent episode of high blood pressure, felt light-headed, and almost fell.
Your boyfriend was with you when this happened.
We found that you have a slightly leaky heart valve, which was seen on an echocardiogram before.
We also noticed a slight heart murmur and some mild swelling in your legs.
Your symptoms may be related to your uncontrolled high blood pressure.
We are considering checking for other possible causes of your high blood pressure, like issues with your hormones or adrenal glands.
You will keep taking lisinopril as your doctor prescribed.
We will talk more about any further tests or next steps in the future.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you had a recent episode of high blood pressure, felt light-headed, and almost fell.
We found out you have a history of high blood pressure, which is usually triggered by traveling for work and not eating well.
Your light-headedness and almost falling may be related to your high blood pressure.
You also have a slightly leaky heart valve, but no other heart problems were found.
You will continue taking lisinopril as prescribed.
The doctor will think about checking for other possible causes of your high blood pressure.
You should monitor your blood pressure regularly and tell the doctor if you have any more episodes or changes in how you feel.
